items.headline: No. 16 Oregon keeps CFP hopes alive with win over Michigan
items.description: Dylan Raiola threw for 341 yards and four touchdowns, and No. 16 Oregon kept its slim chances for a spot in the College Football Playoff alive with a victory over struggling Michigan on Saturday.
